import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import zlib from "node:zlib";
const payload="";
const files=JSON.parse(zlib.gunzipSync(Buffer.from(payload,"base64")).toString("utf8"));
for(const [rel,b64] of Object.entries(files)){const p=path.resolve(rel);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(p),{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(p,Buffer.from(b64,"base64"));}
console.log(`Materialized ${Object.keys(files).length} Moy Mir source files (v0.3.2 robust import fix)`);
